The following events took place in '''0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]''', in the part of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] that preceded the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Standard Calendar. 0 BBY and 0 ABY collectively comprised a single year.

This year was known as '''Year 1,000''' after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and '''Year 3,653''' after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].

==Events==
*[[Firrerreo genocide]]<ref name="TEGtAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
*35:1:9&mdash;[[Taliff]] takes direct control of the government of [[Dentaal/Legends|Dentaal]].<ref name="GNN5:250">{{JournalCite|5|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*[[Freighter/Legends|Freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Kinnin Vo-Shay]] came out of a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] in the [[Tyus Cluster/Legends|Tyus Cluster]], after falling into the other side [[50 BBY|fifty years earlier]].<ref name="The Last Hand">{{JournalCite|13|The Last Hand (short story)}}</ref>
*The [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing]] formally entered [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] service.<ref name="XW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>
*Completion of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> along with the subsequent [[Destruction of Despayre|destruction]] of [[Despayre]].<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
*The [[Blockade of Ralltiir]].<ref name="GNN3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
*[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] by Imperials and brought aboard the Death Star, but the plans were kept by the escaped [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] (35:3:3).<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*35:3:5&mdash;[[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|Dissolution of the Imperial Senate]].<ref name="GNN3" />
*The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] is dissolved by the Empire.<ref name="TCSWE" />
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] joins the Rebel Alliance by leaving [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], R2-D2 and C-3PO.<ref name="ANH" />
*35:3:6&mdash;[[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]].<ref name="35:3:6">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}} dates the [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution of the Imperial Senate]] to [[Great ReSynchronization|35:3:5]], which is the same [[Standard day/Legends|day]] as the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Lars]], according to [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' establishes that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] spend the night in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] following the Lars murders, before embarking upon the [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue of Princess Leia]] the next day, during which the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] also occurs, according to the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]. Therefore, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] rescue and the destruction of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] take place on 35:3:6.</ref>
*35:3:7&mdash;[[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|Rescue of Princess Leia]].<ref name="35:3:6" />
*35:3:8&mdash;[[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Yavindate">{{Yavindate}}</ref>
